name: @sleepymug/fleet-codegen
description: A service's client, made from its schema: a node package whose methods call the service from a box, taking and giving plain objects, with declarations whole in one file that carry the schema's comments, and the service's part of the box's README

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
